name: kiwi-automation-testing
description: KIWI Business Owner (Provider) website – end-to-end automation with Playwright + TypeScript: onboarding a new provider from zero + all provider screens.

scripts.setup: npm ci && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.test:headless: cross-env HEADLESS=true playwright test --project=onboarding && cross-env HEADLESS=true playwright test --project=provider
scripts.auth:provider: node -e "for (const f of ['.auth/provider.json','.auth/provider-booking.json']) { try { require('fs').unlinkSync(f) } catch {} }" && playwright test --project=provider-setup
